profile: margin-perceptron cost: a cost function for linear two-class classification, written g(w) = Σ max(0, 1 − y_p x̌_p^T w). It sums over training examples p the amount by which the margin y_p x̌_p^T w falls below 1; the max(0, ·) term contributes zero when the margin is at least 1 and becomes positive when the margin is below 1.
